The [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] [[Tlinetha]] once picked up that the air around [[Jax Pavan]] shivered as if it was charged, a feeling she had only felt once before in a '''Jedi'''. Tlinetha didn't realize it, but the sensation was due to their [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity]].<ref name="Last Jedi" />
